headline: Home Buyers Now Get a "National Subsidy" Too: Mortgage Interest Subsidy of 1 Percentage Point, Saving Up to Nearly 50,000 Yuan in Interest
summary: Home buyers in China will receive a national mortgage interest subsidy of 1 percentage point, saving up to nearly 50,000 yuan in interest. The measure covers loans including second-hand home purchases.
why: Mortgage policy shapes household borrowing and housing demand, which matter to China's property sector and the banks that lend against it.
